integrity: Mathematical proof and a separate reproducibility script are supplied; numerical checks corroborate but do not certify the infinite and asymptotic claims. Independent validation and definitive historical-priority assessment have not been performed.
limitations: Fixed-shape asymptotics require 0 < eta < 1/10. The simultaneous small-deformation law requires eta/epsilon to converge to a finite nonnegative limit. The theorem concerns exactly three independent arclength-uniform boundary points on a threefold radial oval; it does not give full-area distributions, other shapes, large-sample limits, or uniform results when eta/epsilon diverges.
title: A sharp circle-to-threefold-oval crossover for nearly maximal random inscribed triangles
